items.content:
Both films are about a family unit that has already failed and a system
that offers to take over the job. The horror is not the cult. The horror
is that the cult is *better at it* — more attentive, more ritualised,
more willing to hold the grief in public.

That is a genuinely upsetting proposition and it is why people say they
find him pretentious. They mean they found it unpleasant, which is the
point.

summary: The cult is better at holding a failed family's grief — the real horror
title: Ari Aster, actually
